scope: Unmodified source-built Xiph FLAC 1.5.0 Windows x64; fixed native FLAC to mono 16 kHz s16le PCM, <=1 second, <=1 MiB; experimental only

rights_review.documentation: Preserve full unmodified upstream tar and COPYING.FDL 1.3; no manual excerpts are republished
rights_review.build_recipes: Additional GPL-2.0-or-later on exactly the two codec build scripts and input policy; original Firebird55 Attribution License 1.0 remains an alternative
rights_review.resolution: Copyright holder explicitly approved the limited additional grant on 2026-10-30, without extra visible-credit/link terms on the GPL route; general project license unchanged.
rights_review.historical_blocker: The visible attribution/link condition on the required build recipes has not been established compatible with GPLv2 source-delivery/no-further-restrictions terms. No relicensing or compatibility approval is inferred.

durable_source.coverage: Exact six-input source kit; original unmodified 907-entry upstream tar, complete current build inputs, original alternative license and scoped additional GPL grant
durable_source.publication_guard: Only the exact current and historical path/size/hash tuples are exempt; all content/profile/credential scanning remains active
durable_source.release_policy: After rights resolution, embed the matching complete source kit beside the codec and cohost a named source asset beside each future binary; bind both in checksums/provenance and download-verify before publication. No production release in this review.
durable_source.retention: Retain all source snapshots indefinitely; never remove matching source while any covered binary remains available. Preserve historical source if withdrawing a binary.
durable_source.expiry: Actions artifacts are review evidence only; not the retention service

maintenance.owner: Repository maintainer responsible for R19 codec adoption and releases
maintenance.deputy_rule: If no maintainer can perform a required review, block new binary publication; no assumed coverage

baseline.security_policy: No SECURITY.md/published advisories visible on the inspected upstream security page; not proof of no vulnerabilities

triggers: New upstream release, advisory, relevant bug/fuzzer report or license change
Source retrieval failure, missing ownership or stale review

security_response.stop_new_publication: Immediately for a credible in-scope memory-safety/integrity issue, unavailable source or unresolved scope
security_response.unresolved: Keep publication blocked; patch/rebase with full source and new pins or withdraw affected binary downloads. Retain sources.

maintenance.update_policy: No latest/download/PATH fallback. Prefer a reviewed stable release; otherwise exact reviewed patches with modification notices and source. Rebuild/relink from delivered kit, refresh all hashes and repeat affected Windows/frozen probes.
maintenance.evidence_limits: Source-diff/control-flow triage plus existing fixture evidence; no exploit reproduction, complete fuzzing, predictive-format or clean Windows 11 acceptance
